quest.title: Good as New
quest.description: Bernhard has heard that you are participating in the Fecund Hamper event...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler, Paimon. I've heard that you've been participating in the Fecund Hamper event. Was it fun?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been pretty fun! Paimon isn't sure if it's because there was this market during Weinlesefest, but we got all sorts of decorations.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Haha, there are indeed people who would prepare those as gifts. Right, since we're running a snack shop, do you want to put some of those decorations here?

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Prettying the shop up could help us attract more customers.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Besides, I'm sure the gift givers would be happy to see their sincere gifts being used in your shop.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Good point! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's decorate our shop!
